description.value:
Luck & Risk

Treats every wager, gunfight, and gamble in the wasteland as a table it's already sitting at. Rewards bold bets; punishes hedging. It never cheats — it doesn't have to. It just states the odds exactly and lets the wasteland do the rest.

Areas of Concern gambling, fair odds, cruel reversal of fortune

Edicts state the true odds before any wager; let every game run its full course, win or lose; reward audacity

Anathema rig a game in your own favor; refuse a bet once the terms are set; show mercy to someone who folds early

Religious Symbol a die frozen mid-roll

Sacred Animal magpie

Sacred Colors felt green, chip red, dealer white
